payload.body:
The engineering domains of XDMOD, the repos that hold them, and the documents and
design files in each repo (repo layouts, D68, D71, D78).
claude/: CLAUDE.md, skills, commands, checklists.
A file or a set of files in a repo.
Written under build/<area>/ by a build or check, never committed.
CAD files with trace fields (XD-ADR-0023).
curatrix check results; each failure prints its reproduce command.
checks.yaml: what `curatrix check` runs.
Firmware and test code with Doxygen groups and test IDs.
curatrix/: the framework tool.
docs/documents.yaml: own and upstream documents (zdocs).
One Sphinx document (rst) of the linked document set; it holds authored needs.
The DOMAIN part of every ID: <DOMAIN>-<KIND>-<NNNN>.
views/<view>.drawio.svg: editable SVG.
robarm-ee: KiCad projects and prototype wiring.
need types, Sphinx extensions, SysML library, curatrix, reusable workflows.
xdmod: the framework, in every workspace.
parts/ and assemblies/: uncompressed .FCStd.
Written by curatrix, committed, and compared by `curatrix check` (XD-RULE-0033).
generated/model-needs.json and cad-needs.json.
hil/<setup>/: hardware map, fixtures, runner config.
the linked HTML documents, with llms.txt for agents.
ids.yaml: every ID ever issued, append-only.
robarm-integration: system-level verification (system and integration tests, HIL).
pcba/<name>/: one KiCad project per PCBA.
robarm-manifest: pins, full-set registry, project decisions.
robarm-me: FreeCAD parts and assemblies.
generated/model.json: compact Pilot export.
model/generated/NeedStubs.sysml: requirement stubs.
needs/needs_config.toml: need types and link types.
needs.json of a document, written by its docs build.
A document set's exported needs (needs.json).
The revision a repo is pinned to (west).
proto/<config>/: KiCad or WireViz.
Every repo follows one common layout.
workflows/: GitHub workflows the repos call.
HIL run record on the orphan branch `evidence`.
Written by people or agents.
robarm-sw: Zephyr firmware.
robarm-syseng: requirements and the SysML model.
sysml/: trace and view metadata.
model/*.sysml, one file per SYSMOD step.
tests/: test code with test IDs from the ledger.
requirements.txt and tools.yaml.
west.yml and submanifests: the only place with pins.
One west topdir: xdmod, the manifest repo, the design repos, libraries and Zephyr.
app/ and dts/bindings/: the firmware.

States that the checks read: need status, decision status, suspect links and
evidence validity (D58, D60, D64e, D120, D130).
decision_status of XD-ADR and PRJ-DEC; the newer decision holds the link.
the need is removed; its ID is never issued again

A HIL run record on the evidence branch (XD-RULE-0012, XD-RULE-0013). A new run
writes a new record; a record never changes.
from a PR branch: shown, never counted
SHAs differ: a new run is needed
counts as a test result
a person's commit confirms the link (agents only propose)
the link is deleted or retargeted instead
The status field of every need.
gone from the sources; a generated need keeps a tombstone until the next baseline
structure checks only, no coverage
kept for the grace period; links to it are reported (XD-RULE-0011)
all checks, counts for coverage
the pinned SHAs or the firmware hash differ from the run
the pins are back at the SHAs of the run (e.g. a revert)
a merged change sets status: retired, before the need is deleted
a newer decision changes part of this one
a merged change sets status: valid (the merge is the approval, D51)
a newer decision replaces this one
the link target changed after the link was confirmed
A link held by the concrete need; suspect links block a baseline (XD-RULE-0014).
Need types and link types of XDMOD (trace-model.md, needs_config.toml).
System model elements that became needs.
Domain design: generated from code, KiCad and FreeCAD, or written in rst.
Decisions, rules and checks.

Every need has an ID <DOMAIN>-<KIND>-<NNNN> from the ledger and a status. The link
features are declared here once and specialised by the need types below.
Who wants what: stakeholders and their needs.
EARS requirements.
Results point to the test case they come from.
A test case imported from a JUnit report (sphinx-test-reports).
sphinx-test-reports.
sphinx-test-reports.
TR-<test ID>-<sha8>: one result of one run, with firmware hash and pinned SHAs.
Tests live by what they verify.
Results of test runs and HIL evidence.
The INT domain: system and integration tests in robarm-integration (XD-ADR-0104).
Humans and agents (humans-and-agents.rst, workflow.md §2, D3, D58, D126).
scheduled workflow of the manifest repo
GitHub Actions
SE, EE, ME, SW or integration
sets goals, decides, merges, affirms, makes baselines

The build and check pipeline that `curatrix gen`, `views build`, `docs` and `check`
run, locally and in CI (D40, D46, D65, D96).
One pass over a repo or the full set. The same steps run locally and in CI.
People and agents edit sources on a branch.
Generated files fresh, IDs, graph rules, model, views, tests.
sphinx-needs writes each document's needs.json.
Doxygen groups and ZTEST annotations become SW-IMPL and SW-TC needs.
Read-only SysML stubs of the requirements.
The diagrams of the XDMOD manual.

The kinds of files: sources, committed generated files, build output. The plain source
kinds (documents, models, configuration) are in the repo views.
From sources to needs, views, documents and check results.
A change from the first branch to the published documents.
The need types of electrical engineering (EE) and the trace links inside the domain.
The repo of electrical engineering (EE): its documents and design files.
The two repos outside the domains: the framework and the manifest.
The need types of system-level verification (INT) and the trace links inside the domain.
The repo of system-level verification (INT): its documents and design files.
The need types of mechanical engineering (ME) and the trace links inside the domain.
The repo of mechanical engineering (ME): its documents and design files.
The general need with its link types, and the categories of need types (place in the V).
The scheduled bump of the manifest pins, and publishing.
What every repo has, whatever its domain.
People and agents.
Who does what: people, agents and automation.
The need types of software (SW) and the trace links inside the domain.
The repo of software (SW): its documents and design files.
Trace links from electrical engineering to systems engineering.
Trace links from system-level verification to systems engineering.
Trace links from mechanical engineering to systems engineering.
The need types of systems engineering (SYS) and the trace links inside the domain.
The repo of systems engineering (SYS): its documents and design files.
Trace links from software to systems engineering.
The kinds of test results: run results and imported JUnit reports.
Decisions, rules and checks of the framework and the project.
How needs flow between the repos: from the abstract to the concrete side.
The framework serves every repo; the manifest pins every repo.

Trunk-based change process with agent review and a person's merge (workflow.md §3,
D43, D52, D58, D89, D115, D126).
first-pass review by an agent that did not author the change
authoring work, by an agent or a person, on a branch
run by the scheduled bump bot
One change across one or more repos, with one branch name in every repo.
Required checks; sibling repos resolved to the same branch.
Edit content, regenerate generated files, give placeholder IDs their numbers.
One PR per repo, with sibling PRs, affected needs and the provenance trailer.
Reason and diff for each link the change made suspect.
curatrix work start: worktrees, the same branch name in every repo (D52).
run by GitHub Actions
a decision only the owner makes
a decision only a person makes: the owner or a domain engineer (review, merge, affirm)
Scheduled, independent of any single change: the bump bot moves the manifest pins.
A failing full set is fixed by a normal change in the repo that broke it.
